newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet campaign keeps lead over 1995.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet campaign keeps lead over 1995.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries as of November 8 were 15.24 million tonnes, up from 15.12 million last year, the sugar industry association WVZ said in its seventh report of the 1996/97 campaign.
Sugar content at delivery on November 8 was 18.08 percent, up from 16.71 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final beet deliveries of 26.43 million tonnes, up from a final 26.05 million in 1995/96.
WVZ will run delivery updates on a weekly basis until the end of the campaign in January.
Deliveries to refineries up to November 1 were 12.90 million tonnes, up from 12.71 million last year, and sugar content on that day was 18.02 percent, up from 16.69 percent previously.
